question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Charcoal, Black Colour, Classroom Board
solution:
The diagram that best indicates relation between Charcoal, Black Color and Classroom Board.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4faf69d9a73225bb1e956acebbcc1514cebc538822e5ef704c67882abe463e4.png]

Classroom board are found in Black, Green and White color.
